en.title: Iran shifts uranium stockpile, orders response to U.S. and Israel, amid tanker incident in Strait of Hormuz
en.dek: Iran announced a shift of its uranium stockpile abroad and a reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, while its leadership ordered a broad response to U.S. and Israeli threats.
facts: Four oil tankers struck mines and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz on 31 October.
Iran announced it will shift its uranium stockpile abroad and reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days under a draft deal on 31 October.
Khamenei ordered the Revolutionary Guard Corps to update its target list to include all U.S. and Israeli assets and to respond immediately to any threat on 31 October.
Donald Trump received a briefing from CENTCOM chief on options for strikes against Iran on 30 October.
Qatar renewed mediation efforts for U.S.–Iran talks on 30 October.
Ukraine paused strikes on Russian oil refineries after pressure from Trump on 30 October.
body: Four oil tankers struck mines and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz on 31 October, according to yoursun.com and Al Jazeera. The incident involved four tankers that were hit by mines and subsequently ignited.

Iran announced it will shift its uranium stockpile abroad and reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days under a draft deal, according to the Times of India and the Economic Times. The announcement was made on 31 October as part of the draft agreement.

Khamenei ordered the Revolutionary Guard Corps to update its target list to include all U.S. and Israeli assets and to respond immediately to any threat, according to the Jerusalem Post and Axios. The order was issued on 31 October and applies to all tangible and intangible assets within reach of Iranian forces.

Earlier, Donald Trump received a briefing from CENTCOM chief on options for strikes against Iran, according to Türkiye Today and Around Prague. The briefing took place on 30 October and was part of ongoing diplomatic and military discussions.

Qatar renewed mediation efforts for U.S.–Iran talks, according to Modern Diplomacy and Iran International. Qatar revived peace efforts on 30 October and offered to meet Iranian officials as part of the renewed dialogue.

Ukraine paused strikes on Russian oil refineries after pressure from Trump, according to the Jerusalem Post and the Times of India. The pause was announced on 30 October and followed U.S. pressure on the conflict.
en.context: The June 2026 Iranian presidential election installed a new administration, prompting Washington to reassess its strategy. U.S. midterm elections are approaching, and tensions in the Middle East remain high.

de.dek: Präsident Trump erhielt Briefings über Optionen für Angriffe auf den Iran, während Nationaler Sicherheitsberater J.D. Vance diplomatische Annäherungen suchte und das Pentagon Generalleutnant Brett Sylvia wegen Leaks entließ.
body: Am 30. Oktober 2026 erhielt Präsident Donald Trump laut Türkiye Today und Around Prague ein Briefing über mögliche Angriffsoptionen gegen den Iran. Das Briefing fand statt, während parallel dazu diplomatische Bemühungen fortgesetzt wurden.

Am Vortag informierte der Chef des U.S. Central Command, Admiral Brad Cooper, Trump über eine potenzielle Seeblockade des Iran sowie über Angriffsszenarien, wie Axios und Ynetnews berichteten. Das Briefing war Teil einer Überprüfung erneuter militärischer Optionen nach der iranischen Wahl.

Der Nationale Sicherheitsberater J.D. Vance schickte laut The Jerusalem Post und Der Spiegel einen Brief nach Teheran, in dem er feststellte, dass die Vermeidung erneuter US-Angriffe Nuklearverhandlungen erfordern würde. Der Brief trug das Datum 29. Oktober 2026.

Vance schrieb zudem an den hochrangigen iranischen Sicherheitschef Mohsen Rezaei und drängte auf eine zügige Rückkehr zu Verhandlungen, wie Euronews und Al Jazeera berichteten. Die Korrespondenz zielte darauf ab, die Friedensgespräche nach der Wahl wieder aufzunehmen.

Verteidigungsminister Pete Hegseth entließ Generalleutnant Brett Sylvia aus seiner Position als Leiter für Strategie, Planung und Politik, nachdem das Pentagon zu dem Schluss gekommen war, dass er geheime Informationen über den Iran und die Ukraine durchgestochen habe, so CNBC und The Hindu. Die Maßnahme wurde zum Schutz von Geheimmaterial ergriffen.

Sylvia gab später zu, die geheimen Daten über einen Zeitraum von einem Jahr an zwei Reporter weitergegeben zu haben, laut einem internen Bericht, den Axios und die Times of India zitierten. Die Leaks betrafen sowohl die Iran- als auch die Ukraine-Konflikte.

Trump sagte persönliche Kundgebungen in Salina, Kansas, und Dubuque, Iowa, ab und ersetzte diese durch Fernsehübertragungen in fast 20 Bundesstaaten, laut The Jerusalem Post und Al Jazeera. Das Nationale Komitee der Republikaner gab den Übertragungsplan am 30. Oktober 2026 bekannt.

Die Briefings und die diplomatischen Annäherungen folgen auf die iranische Präsidentschaftswahl im Juni 2026, die laut Ynetnews nach Angaben von US-Beamten die regionale Stabilität beeinflussen könnte.

body: On 30 October 2026, President Donald Trump received a briefing on possible strike options against Iran, according to Türkiye Today and Around Prague. The briefing occurred as diplomatic efforts continued in parallel.

The day before, U.S. Central Command chief Admiral Brad Cooper briefed Trump on a potential naval blockade of Iran and on strike scenarios, as reported by Axios and Ynetnews. The briefing was part of a review of renewed military options after the Iranian election.

National Security Advisor J.D. Vance sent a letter to Tehran stating that avoiding renewed U.S. strikes would require nuclear negotiations, according to The Jerusalem Post and Der Spiegel. The letter was dated 29 October 2026.

Vance also wrote to senior Iranian security chief Mohsen Rezaei urging a swift return to negotiations, reported by Euronews and Al Jazeera. The correspondence aimed to revive peace talks following the election.

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth removed Lieutenant General Brett Sylvia from his position as head of strategy, plans and policy after the Pentagon concluded he leaked classified information about Iran and Ukraine, per CNBC and The Hindu. The action was taken to protect classified material.

Sylvia later admitted leaking the classified data to two reporters over a one‑year period, according to an internal report cited by Axios and the Times of India. The leaks covered both the Iran and Ukraine conflicts.

Trump cancelled in‑person rallies scheduled for Salina, Kansas and Dubuque, Iowa and replaced them with televised broadcasts in nearly 20 states, according to The Jerusalem Post and Al Jazeera. The Republican National Committee announced the broadcast plan on 30 October 2026.
The briefings and diplomatic outreach follow the Iranian presidential election held in June 2026, which U.S. officials said could affect regional stability, according to Ynetnews.

Vance kontaktierte den hochrangigen iranischen Sicherheitschef Mohsen Rezaei und drängte auf eine zügige Rückkehr zu Verhandlungen (Euronews, Al Jazeera).

de.context: Die Vereinigten Staaten haben nach den jüngsten Wahlen im Iran militärische Optionen gegen das Land abgewogen und gleichzeitig diplomatische Kanäle genutzt, um das Risiko eines erneuten Konflikts zu verringern.

en.dek: Trump swapped weekend rallies for televised broadcasts while U.S. officials briefed him on a possible Iran blockade and Vance pursued diplomatic outreach.
body: The Republican National Committee announced that President Trump will replace his canceled weekend rallies with televised broadcasts in nearly 20 states, according to Al Jazeera and CNA.
The cancellations involved in‑person events scheduled for Saturday in Salina, Kansas and Sunday in Dubuque, Iowa, as reported by The Jerusalem Post and The Straits Times.

U.S. Central Command chief Admiral Brad Cooper briefed President Trump on a potential naval blockade of Iran and on possible strike scenarios, according to Axios, while Ynetnews added that the briefing also covered renewed war options.

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth removed Lieutenant General Brett Sylvia from his position heading strategy, plans and policy, and the Pentagon later announced Sylvia’s dismissal for leaking classified information about the Iran and Ukraine wars, per CNBC, The Hindu, Al Jazeera and Die Welt.
An internal Pentagon report said Sylvia admitted to leaking the classified data to two reporters over a one‑year period, as detailed by Axios and the Times of India.
National Security Advisor J.D. Vance sent a letter to Tehran stating that avoiding renewed U.S. strikes will require nuclear negotiations, according to The Jerusalem Post and Der Spiegel.
Vance also reached out to senior Iranian security chief Mohsen Rezaei, urging a swift return to negotiations, reported by Euronews and Al Jazeera.
EA WorldView and The Washington Post confirmed that Vance approached Tehran more broadly to discuss potential talks, indicating a coordinated diplomatic initiative.
